```{r}
cards <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(D$machines)), function(i) {
  mm <- D$machines[i, ]
  div(class = "rs-card",
      div(class = "rs-card-title", mm$machine, " ", machine_badge(mm$machine)),
      tags$dl(class = "rs-kv",
        tags$dt("Platform"), tags$dd(paste(mm$os, mm$arch)),
        tags$dt("CPU"), tags$dd(mm$cpu),
        tags$dt("OS / kernel"), tags$dd(mm$kernel),
        tags$dt("Toolchain"), tags$dd(mm$toolchain),
        tags$dt("Profiler"), tags$dd(mm$profiler),
        tags$dt("Wake"), tags$dd(mm$wake),
        tags$dt("Since"), tags$dd(paste("R", mm$first_version))
      )
  )
})
div(class = "rs-grid3", cards)
```

```{r}
m <- REF_MACHINE
s <- D$runs[D$runs$machine == m & D$runs$kind == "devel", ]
s <- s[order(s$date), ]
p <- plot_ly(s, x = ~date, height = 300) |>
  add_markers(y = ~sentinel_drift, showlegend = FALSE,
              marker = list(size = ifelse(s$suspect, 11, 6), symbol = ifelse(s$suspect, "x-thin-open", "circle"),
                            color = ifelse(s$suspect, LIGHT[["ink"]], LIGHT[["series1"]]),
                            line = list(width = ifelse(s$suspect, 2, 0), color = LIGHT[["ink"]])),
              text = sprintf("%s · sentinel %+.1f%%%s", fmt_date(s$date), 100 * s$sentinel_drift,
                             ifelse(s$suspect, " · ⚠ suspect", "")), hoverinfo = "text")
band <- list(type = "rect", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = -0.03, y1 = 0.03,
             fillcolor = LIGHT[["band"]], line = list(width = 0), layer = "below")
ev <- D$events[D$events$machine == m, ]
vl <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ev)), function(i) list(type = "line", yref = "paper", y0 = 0, y1 = 1,
             x0 = ev$date[i], x1 = ev$date[i], line = list(color = LIGHT[["muted"]], width = 1)))
div(class = "rs-card",
  div(class = "rs-card-title", paste("Sentinel drift,", m)),
  div(class = "rs-card-sub", "Relative to the rolling median of previous sessions. Band: ±3% tolerance; vertical lines: machine changes."),
  rs_layout(p, x = ax(NULL, type = "date"), y = ax("Drift", tickformat = "+.0%", range = c(-0.08, 0.08)),
            legend = FALSE, shapes = c(list(band), vl))
)
```

## Change log

```{r}
ev <- D$events[order(D$events$date, decreasing = TRUE), ]
rs_table(data.frame(Date = fmt_date(ev$date), Machine = ev$machine, Change = ev$event),
         pagination = FALSE, columns = list(Change = colDef(minWidth = 380)))
```

::: {.rs-notes}
- Machines are dedicated bare metal. They sleep when idle and are woken when work is queued.
- Each session runs `bench doctor` and `bench denoise`, then a fixed **sentinel** benchmark. A sentinel more than 3% off the recent median marks the session *suspect*: published, but excluded from change detection.
- Kernel, firmware and toolchain updates happen only in maintenance windows and are logged above, because they can move every number.
:::
